name: yara
title: YARA
description: Scans files and folders with YARA: the bundled Yara-Rules subset (crypto constants, packers, anti-debug/anti-VM, capabilities), your own rule files, or inline rules. Targets are read from the folder mounted at /work; extra rule files can be mounted at /rules. No network.
license: MIT (MCP server, FuzzingLabs) AND BSD-3-Clause (YARA) AND GPL-2.0-only (bundled Yara-Rules)

mounts.description: The folder to scan (read-only is enough)
A folder with your own .yar rule files

notes: Inline rules may not use include. Directory scans do not follow symbolic links.
